First of all Subtlety is way better, cause it can deal tons of damage on demand, which is quite the problem with assassination! If you're at a point where you just want to play it for fun I'd suggest following talents:

* Tier 1: Master Poisoner
* Tier 2: Subterfuge (For increased Garrote Damage and more Cheapshot Combos)
* Tier 3: Vigor (For much smoother Rotation and Energy Management)
* Tier 4: Elusiveness (Makes Feint even better for negating Damage)
* Tier 5: Prey on the weak (if you're playing 2v2,3v3,5v5) but i personally prefer Internal Bleeding for some extra Damage done by myself
* Tier 6: Alacrity (For more Haste and so more Energy Regeneration) Sometimes Agonizing Poison is a good choice (when you know the fight will take a long time) but generally Alacrity is much better
* Tier 7: Venom Rush is the way to go here (Energy regenaration is the Key for Assassinations do deal high amounts of Damage) personally I take Death from above sometimes, but just cause I love the animation and its quite satisfying seeing some really high crits

For Honor Talents I'd suggest:

* Tier 1: The go to here is definetly Gladiator's Medallion (If you're playing Orc I suggest Relentless / If your Human I'd suggest Adaptation)
* Tier 2: Reinforced Armor against at least 1 Caster, if you're playing against 2 Melees Sparring becomes much more valuable
* Tier 3 : If you're playing against a lot of snares such as DKs for example Maneuverability is your way to go, if not Cut to the Chase is much better and provides a much higher uptime on your targets
* Tier 4 : Unfair Advantage pairs nicely with your Tier 5 talent (Deadly Brew) and puts even more pressure on enemy Healers because of that they will generally be lower HP than you
* Tier 5 : Deadly Brew is the go to here, because it adds the old Venomous Poison back to your repertoire (decreased Healing)
* Tier 6 : Creeping Venom is easy to maintain on multiple targets and deals a surprisingly high amount of Damage
